card.name: Hard and young before nouns
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "hard" (or "harder") as an adjective before a noun such as work or core, in older narrative prose. It also fires on "young" before a noun and on "of" after "rate" or "basis".

modes.label: Hard as adjective
modes.description: The word hard or harder modifying a noun, as in hard work or a harder master.
modes.example: All their plans for the future, all the fruits of their<< hard>> work, the little homes gained after coming

modes.label: Young before noun
modes.description: The word young placed before a noun like village or immigrant.
modes.example: who now had thrown in his fortunes with the rising<< young>> village of Milwaukee.

modes.label: Of after a noun
modes.description: The word of after a noun like rate or basis, leading into a following phrase.
modes.example: planned to drill wells itself at the rate<< of>> one every twenty days

card.plain: It marks adjectives like hard or young that sit just before a noun in historical prose.
